challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: We need to move the hand-off into the orchestration layer so it runs without manual triggering. Right now, every time a person has to click that button by hand, we open a gap in the audit trail. The more of this process we automate, the fewer gaps show up later. I want the shadow environment to handle that transition automatically, so the live forecast stays protected and the record stays clean. More automation here means less risk of a silent failure slipping through the cracks.
output.reclassify_reason: The text states a need for automation to close audit gaps and protect the live forecast, and indicates that doing more than the minimum (fully automating the transition) would make the author happier by further reducing the risk of silent failures.
